title: Phonidex
summary: A turntable simulator that puts a DJ's deck on your iPhone. Designed and built in SwiftUI.
intro: A turntable in your pocket. Load a track from your phone and play it like you would on a real deck: scratch the platter, set cue points and ride the pitch fader.
